title: T78 + T79: vendor playbooks 0.6.0 (96 r1 still packs) and POST /avatars/import; 0.7.56
head: t79-pack-import-pr
body:
## What
- **T78 (#338):** `vendor/playbooks-0.6.0-py3-none-any.whl` from RDW-Labz/playbooks `4d6de2a` (PR #18) by pin, own PROVENANCE entry (#281): 96 still packs `<theme>-NN-r1` across arcade, space, desert, robot, office, pets, fantasy, hitchhiker, with 512 px portraits under `garage/avatars/portraits/<id>.png` served as thumbs (cap 256 KB, #337). Bundled-dir / live-route tests now expect 8 motion + 96 stills; service CLI reports the 0.6.0 pin.
- **T79 (#339):** `POST /avatars/import` (bearer-protected, multipart folder/zip): structural validation only — real PNG, parseable manifest, safe names, no path escapes, no symlinks; stored in the drawer as `source: drawer`; listed under "Your own"; one audit event (metadata only); plain-word errors. **No hard size/pixel/quality limits**; the response carries `recommendation` when a file is far outside the recommended sizes. docs/local-service.md updated.
- **Perf (CI 30 s fault timeout with 106 packs):** bundled (trusted) packs are checked structurally only (signature, IHDR, chunk CRCs, IDAT inflate length) and cached per pack; drawer imports keep the strict pixel-level checks (palette range etc.). Live-route test 41 s -> 4 s; new timing test: list + every thumb < 5 s. Bundled-route tests sample packs per route and assert the full id set once.
- Version 0.7.55 -> 0.7.56, CHANGELOG, uv.lock.

## Why
Braden 2026-10-01: eight theme packs in the real app (decision #338); let people add their own avatars later with no restrictions, a suggestion only (#339). Desktop wiring of the T77 "Add a pack" drop target follows in desktop-app.

## Checks
<!-- swarm:checks -->

## Mutation check
Six mutants on the import path, each applied alone, each killed by a named test (spec `docs/_swarm/t79-mutants.json` in the build worktree): m1 path escape accepted → fail; m2 manifest-less pack accepted → fail; m3 audit skipped → fail; m4 recommendation missing for an oversized file → fail; m5 non-PNG accepted → fail; m6 route without bearer → fail. 6/6 killed; no ask-first gate touched.

## Open
- Rig restart onto this (Braden, #126): one restart covers 0.7.49–0.7.56; then the Coworkers page lists the eight themes.
- Orchestrator note (#159): with no hard cap, a runaway multi-GB file would be accepted; a generous safety ceiling is NOT enforced per #339 — Braden can ask for one.
- Hand steps named: vendor commit, version bump + lock, suite + mutants run.
